simple.meaning: בִּטָּחוֹן (biṭṭâchôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “trust.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H986. bittachon בִּטָּחוֺן noun masculine trust 2Kin 18:19 = Isa 36:4 ; hope Eccl 9:4 .
